notes: Fastned "Model 3 Standard Range (2020 - 2023)" curve, measured on a European CCS2 300 kW charger (market EU/CCS2), battery around 30 C, 10-90 % SoC, 170 kW max. EU CCS2; NA Supercharger early peak ~250 kW (the SR+ is capped lower, 170 kW max; InsideEVs quotes 170 kW peak / 82 kW 20-80 % average for Fastned's 2020 SR+, the curve gives about 81 kW time-weighted). Fastned's label spans 2020-2023, so it may include the 2021-23 cars: Bjorn Nyland measured the 2021 SR+ (55 kWh) slower (159 kW peak, 64 kW 20-80 % average), so that car is not given this curve. The 2019 cars are outside the label and the plain Standard Range (45 kWh usable) pack is not documented; match to these 53 kWh NCA cars is unproven.
